question: تعداد تراکنش و مجموع مقدار به تفکیک شرکت و نوع سند

sql.SQL: SELECT la.company_name AS la_company_name, la.voucher_type AS la_voucher_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.company_name, la.voucher_type ORDER BY la.company_name, la_quantity_sum DESC

question: مجموع مقدار به واحد اصلی به تفکیک انبار و کالا

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, la.part_major_unit_title AS la_part_major_unit_title, SUM(la.major_quantity) AS la_major_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name, la.product_code, la.product_title, la.part_major_unit_title ORDER BY la.store_code, la_major_quantity_sum DESC

question: انبارهایی با میانگین مقدار بالای صد

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, AVG(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_avg, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name HAVING AVG(la.quantity) > 100 ORDER BY la_quantity_avg DESC

question: کالاهایی با مجموع مقدار بالای هزار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title HAVING SUM(la.quantity) > 1000 ORDER BY la_quantity_sum DESC

question: مجموع مقدار ورودی و خروجی به تفکیک مرکز نگهداری

sql.SQL: SELECT la.plant_code AS la_plant_code, la.plant_name AS la_plant_name, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS net_quantity FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.plant_code, la.plant_name ORDER BY net_quantity DESC

question: مجموع مقدار ورودی و خروجی به تفکیک طبقه حساب کالا

sql.SQL: SELECT la.part_account_category_title AS la_part_account_category_title, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS net_quantity FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.part_account_category_title IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.part_account_category_title ORDER BY net_quantity DESC

question: تحلیل ماهانه گردش کالا

sql.SQL: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.voucher_date) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.voucher_date) AS month, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.voucher_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.voucher_date) ORDER BY year, month

question: تحلیل ماهانه گردش کالا به تفکیک نوع تاثیر

sql.SQL: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.voucher_date) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.voucher_date) AS month, la.type_of_effect AS la_type_of_effect, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_date IS NOT NULL AND la.type_of_effect IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.voucher_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.voucher_date), la.type_of_effect ORDER BY year, month, la.type_of_effect

question: پراکندگی کالاها در انبارها

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, COUNT(DISTINCT la.store_code) AS store_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.plant_code) AS plant_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title ORDER BY store_count DESC, la_quantity_sum DESC

question: مجموع مقدار کالاها به تفکیک شرکت، شعبه، مرکز نگهداری و انبار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.company_name AS la_company_name, la.branch_title AS la_branch_title, la.plant_code AS la_plant_code, la.plant_name AS la_plant_name, la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.company_name, la.branch_title, la.plant_code, la.plant_name, la.store_code, la.store_name ORDER BY la.company_name, la.branch_title, la.plant_code, la_quantity_sum DESC

question: کالاهایی که فقط در یک انبار موجود هستند

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, MIN(la.store_code) AS la_store_code, MIN(la.store_name) AS la_store_name, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.store_code) = 1 ORDER BY la_quantity_sum DESC

question: انبارهایی که فقط یک نوع کالا دارند

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, MIN(la.product_code) AS la_product_code, MIN(la.product_title) AS la_product_title, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) = 1 ORDER BY la_quantity_sum DESC

question: مقایسه واحد اصلی و واحد دوم به تفکیک کالا

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, la.part_major_unit_title AS la_part_major_unit_title, la.second_unit_title AS la_second_unit_title, SUM(la.major_quantity) AS la_major_quantity_sum, SUM(la.second_quantity) AS la_second_quantity_sum, CASE WHEN SUM(la.second_quantity) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(la.major_quantity) AS DECIMAL) / SUM(la.second_quantity), 2) ELSE NULL END AS conversion_ratio FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.second_quantity IS NOT NULL AND la.second_quantity > 0 GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title, la.part_major_unit_title, la.second_unit_title ORDER BY la_major_quantity_sum DESC

question: تعداد روزهای فعال به تفکیک انبار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.voucher_date) AS active_days, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name ORDER BY active_days DESC

question: تعداد روزهای فعال به تفکیک کالا

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, COUNT(DISTINCT la.voucher_date) AS active_days, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title ORDER BY active_days DESC

question: آخرین تاریخ تراکنش به تفکیک انبار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, MAX(la.voucher_date) AS last_transaction_date FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name ORDER BY last_transaction_date DESC

question: آخرین تاریخ تراکنش به تفکیک کالا

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, MAX(la.voucher_date) AS last_transaction_date FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title ORDER BY last_transaction_date DESC

question: اولین و آخرین تاریخ تراکنش به تفکیک انبار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, MIN(la.voucher_date) AS first_transaction_date, MAX(la.voucher_date) AS last_transaction_date FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name ORDER BY la.store_code

question: مقایسه مقدار کالاها بین شرکت‌های مختلف

sql.SQL: SELECT la.company_name AS la_company_name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) AS unique_product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.store_code) AS unique_store_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.company_name ORDER BY la_quantity_sum DESC

question: تحلیل گردش کالا به تفکیک روش قیمت‌گذاری

sql.SQL: SELECT la.pricing_method AS la_pricing_method, la.type_of_effect AS la_type_of_effect, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) AS unique_product_count FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.pricing_method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.pricing_method, la.type_of_effect ORDER BY la.pricing_method, la_quantity_sum DESC

question: مجموع مقدار و تعداد تراکنش به تفکیک سال مالی و نوع سند

sql.SQL: SELECT la.fiscal_year_title AS la_fiscal_year_title, la.voucher_type AS la_voucher_type, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.fiscal_year_title, la.voucher_type ORDER BY la.fiscal_year_title, la_quantity_sum DESC

question: بررسی توزیع کالاها بین شعب مختلف

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, COUNT(DISTINCT la.branch_title) AS branch_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title ORDER BY branch_count DESC, la_quantity_sum DESC

question: کالاهایی که در تمام شعب موجود هستند

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, COUNT(DISTINCT la.branch_title) AS branch_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.branch_title) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT branch_title) FROM logistics_allparts) ORDER BY la_quantity_sum DESC

question: میانگین تراکنش روزانه به تفکیک انبار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT la.voucher_date) AS active_days, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT la.voucher_date), 0), 2) AS avg_daily_transactions FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.voucher_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name ORDER BY avg_daily_transactions DESC

question: بررسی تنوع نوع کالا در هر انبار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.part_type) AS part_type_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) AS unique_product_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name ORDER BY part_type_count DESC

question: بررسی تنوع طبقه حساب کالا در هر انبار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.part_account_category_title) AS category_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) AS unique_product_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name ORDER BY category_count DESC

question: مجموع مقدار کالاها با فیلتر بر نوع تاثیر افزایشی

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, SUM(la.quantity) AS incoming_quantity FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name, la.product_code, la.product_title ORDER BY incoming_quantity DESC

question: مجموع مقدار کالاها با فیلتر بر نوع تاثیر کاهشی

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, SUM(la.quantity) AS outgoing_quantity FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name, la.product_code, la.product_title ORDER BY outgoing_quantity DESC

question: نسبت ورودی به خروجی به تفکیک کالا

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_quantity, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) ELSE NULL END AS in_out_ratio FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title ORDER BY in_out_ratio DESC NULLS LAST

question: نسبت ورودی به خروجی به تفکیک انبار

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_quantity, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) ELSE NULL END AS in_out_ratio FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name ORDER BY in_out_ratio DESC NULLS LAST

question: تحلیل جامع گردش کالا به تفکیک شرکت و سال مالی

sql.SQL: SELECT la.company_name AS la_company_name, la.fiscal_year_title AS la_fiscal_year_title, COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) AS unique_product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.store_code) AS unique_store_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_quantity, SUM(la.quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.company_name, la.fiscal_year_title ORDER BY la.company_name, la.fiscal_year_title

question: داشبورد جامع وضعیت انبارها

sql.SQL: SELECT la.store_code AS la_store_code, la.store_name AS la_store_name, la.storage_type_title AS la_storage_type_title, COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) AS unique_product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.part_type) AS part_type_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_quantity, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, MIN(la.voucher_date) AS first_transaction, MAX(la.voucher_date) AS last_transaction FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.store_code, la.store_name, la.storage_type_title ORDER BY transaction_count DESC

question: داشبورد جامع وضعیت کالاها

sql.SQL: SELECT la.product_code AS la_product_code, la.product_title AS la_product_title, la.part_type AS la_part_type, la.part_account_category_title AS la_part_account_category_title, COUNT(DISTINCT la.store_code) AS store_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.plant_code) AS plant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'افزایشی' THEN la.major_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_major_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN la.type_of_effect = 'کاهشی' THEN la.major_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_major_quantity, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.product_code, la.product_title, la.part_type, la.part_account_category_title ORDER BY transaction_count DESC

question: تحلیل جامع مراکز نگهداری

sql.SQL: SELECT la.plant_code AS la_plant_code, la.plant_name AS la_plant_name, la.branch_title AS la_branch_title, COUNT(DISTINCT la.store_code) AS store_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) AS unique_product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.part_type) AS part_type_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, MIN(la.voucher_date) AS first_transaction, MAX(la.voucher_date) AS last_transaction FROM logistics_allparts AS la GROUP BY la.plant_code, la.plant_name, la.branch_title ORDER BY total_quantity DESC

question: گزارش جامع گردش کالا با تمام ابعاد تحلیلی

sql.SQL: SELECT la.company_name AS la_company_name, la.branch_title AS la_branch_title, la.plant_name AS la_plant_name, la.store_name AS la_store_name, la.part_type AS la_part_type, la.voucher_type AS la_voucher_type, la.type_of_effect AS la_type_of_effect, COUNT(DISTINCT la.product_code) AS unique_product_count, SUM(la.quantity) AS la_quantity_sum, SUM(la.major_quantity) AS la_major_quantity_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM logistics_allparts AS la WHERE la.part_type IS NOT NULL AND la.voucher_type IS NOT NULL AND la.type_of_effect IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.company_name, la.branch_title, la.plant_name, la.store_name, la.part_type, la.voucher_type, la.type_of_effect ORDER BY la.company_name, la.branch_title, la.plant_name, la_quantity_sum DESC
